Practical STEM Mastery

Every Science Candidate Conducts Individual Lab Bench Experiments

Unlike crowded centres where students merely observe teacher demonstrations, Grace Christian provides 120 fully equipped workstations for individual UNEB Chemistry qualitative analysis, Physics mechanics, and Biology specimen dissection.

120 BenchesIndividual Lab Stations
3 LabsDedicated Physics, Chem, Bio

Upper Secondary STEM

Advanced Level Science Combinations

Prescribed three-principal subject combinations approved by the Ministry of Education and Sports for university matriculation.

PCB / Sub-MathsUACE Science Stream

Physics, Chemistry, Biology

Mandatory Subsidiary: Sub-Mathematics & General Paper

Career Destinations: Direct entry into Medicine, Surgery, Dental Surgery, Nursing, and Veterinary Sciences.

PCM / Sub-ICTUACE Science Stream

Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics

Mandatory Subsidiary: Computer Studies & General Paper

Career Destinations: Civil, Electrical & Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, and Physical Sciences.

BCM / Sub-MathsUACE Science Stream

Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics

Mandatory Subsidiary: Sub-Mathematics & General Paper

Career Destinations: Pharmacy, Food Science & Technology, Biochemistry, and Agricultural Engineering.

MEG / Sub-ICTUACE Science Stream

Mathematics, Economics, Geography

Mandatory Subsidiary: Computer Studies & General Paper

Career Destinations: Quantitative Economics, Actuarial Science, Statistics, and Urban Planning.

Upper Secondary Arts & Social Sciences

Advanced Level Humanities Combinations

HEL / DivinityUACE Arts Stream

History, Economics, Literature

HGL / Sub-MathsUACE Arts Stream

History, Geography, Literature

Mandatory Subsidiary: Sub-Mathematics & General Paper

EGM / Sub-ICTUACE Arts Stream

Economics, Geography, Mathematics

DEL / HistoryUACE Arts Stream

Academic Rigour

UNEB Examination Mastery

Our scholars do not enter examinations relying on luck. We operate a structured, tested revision framework that guarantees peak performance.

01

Standardized UNEB Mock Examinations

Candidates undergo three comprehensive mock assessment series simulating exact UNEB exam conditions and timing.

02

Bi-Weekly Practical Science Labs

Every candidate performs individual bench experiments in Chemistry qualitative analysis, Physics mechanics, and Biology specimen dissection.

03

Specialized Revision Symposia

Joint inter-school academic seminars held with top secondary schools across Northern and Central Uganda.

04

Past-Paper Analytical Archive

A physical and digital archive spanning 20 years of UNEB past question papers with official examiner marking guides.
